# RTL Arena

> A reproducible benchmark of how well AI coding tools handle Arabic / right-to-left.

RTL Arena (part of Otto, dev.ottospace.co) scores AI coding tools — Cursor, Claude, Copilot, v0,
Lovable — on right-to-left / Arabic UI. Each tool is given the same 15 prompts; its output is
graded automatically by the Otto linters (rtlint + arabitype + dls-check). Fewer RTL/Arabic
issues = higher score. The "RTL" academic name collision (hardware register-transfer-level) means
the right-to-left correctness benchmark space is otherwise unclaimed.

## Use it
- Prompts + scorer: `npx github:moradothmanepro-OTTO/rtl-arena`
- Contribute a tool's results via PR.

Links: https://github.com/moradothmanepro-OTTO/rtl-arena · https://dev.ottospace.co
